They talk NXT competing with an upcoming ROH/NJPW show in NYC, Their experience at Ring of Honor: Best in the World, Triple H hate,  Jeff Jarrett returning to TNA and the possible future of Global Force

items.title: Mat Men Ep. 133 - Money Money Yea Yea
items.description: Bang bang! Mat Men drops another huge elbow on you this week with an episode that covers NXT Takeover: The End, RAW, BSOJ, the brand split, the future of NXT, and much more. They then interview former WWE superstar JTG in a fun interview that covers a variety of topics.

items.title: Mat Men Ep. 100 - 100th Episode Spectacular
items.description: This week the guys celebrate their 100th episode! You've been with them from the beginning and now they take you on yet another magical journey into the world of pro wrestling. This week they read some tweets from fans live on air and talk about the man...Seth Rollins, Night of Champions, NXT, Sting
